svg.aria-label: What's in the box: a dispatched OMP run is observed and cancelled through the shipped contract, captures a real question as attempt-correlated durable evidence, parks while the attempt and worker request end, and continues the same saved session after an answer. A fence marks that the runtime holds nothing durable and the manager owns the task, the inbox and the answer. Host tool-permission policy is composed in unchanged. The manager, inbox, answer action and operator surface are reused as is. Not built: upstream pi, an operator console, a second inbox or answer verb, operator-approved tool execution, worker suspension or live-held wait, a bespoke HTTP answer channel, a shared pi and OMP layer.

g.text: IN THE BOX · WHAT A DISPATCHED OMP RUN GETS
Dispatched, observed, cancelled on the shipped contract
A real question, captured as durable attempt evidence
The task parks; the attempt and the request end
An answer continues the same saved session, later
The runtime holds nothing durable. The manager owns
the task, the inbox and the answer.
COMPOSED IN BY THE HOST
Tool permissions stay the host's
configured allow / deny policy.
REUSED AS IS, NOT REBUILT
The harness manager, the inbox,
the answer action and the
existing operator surface.
NOT BUILT — REFUSED BY THIS SET
Upstream pi support
An operator console or FSD-in-pi extension
A second inbox or answer verb
Operator-approved tool execution
Worker suspension or live-held human wait
A bespoke HTTP answer channel · a shared pi/OMP layer
